name: Ching-Teng Yu (游鏡騰)
positioning: Course Design | Making Knowledge Clear | Experiential Teaching
summary: I have many years of experience in environmental education, course development, and teaching. I am good at turning complex knowledge into learning experiences that are easy to understand and join, based on learning goals and the needs of each audience. I can bring together content research, course structure, and material and activity design. I keep improving through on-site teaching, observation, and feedback.

cases.title: Climate Resilience Course Development: Course Structure and Quality Across Courses
cases.text: I took part in developing six climate resilience courses, bringing together an abstract topic, learning needs, and teamwork. I was in charge of the development structure, trial teaching, and quality integration. I led the improvement of two courses and one new lesson plan, and revised them based on feedback.

cases.title: Food Carbon Detective: Making Knowledge Clear Through Game-Based Learning
cases.text: I turned food carbon emissions and low-carbon eating into a game-based, hands-on learning experience, and kept improving it through real teaching and feedback. The mature version had 30 or more sessions and 800 or more participant visits from 2025 to 2026.

cases.title: Hunting Miracle: Simulation Game and Learning Mechanism Design
cases.text: I turned hunting, limited resources, and environmental ethics into a simulation game. With probability, resource limits, and player decisions, learners see cooperation, role sharing, and resource management through feedback from the system. The teaching experience was improved over several versions.
